title: 第10章 出殡
slug: 灵棺夜行全本免费-灵棺夜行最新章节列表
content_zh:
刚入夜，村子就静的可怕。
我跟瞎子来到名花流岸。
河流并不宽也就七八米，桥是青石桥。
我拿了四根红蜡烛摆在桥的四个角，然后划拉柴火给点上。
烛火在黑夜中闪耀着如同四团妖异的鬼火在夜中颤悚。
这是真正的指路灯。
瞎子叮嘱道：“是红蜡烛，别拿错了。”
红白相反。
我道：“没错，是红蜡烛。”
我紧接着又拿了一个小铜鼎摆到桥头中央，再烧一柱香，然后特别恭敬的把香插进小铜鼎。
嘴里叽里咕噜的念了一段瞎子教我的咒语。
念完我就忘记自己念了啥了。
我担心没念对就问瞎子：“我念对了吗？”
瞎子青黑的脸上难得露出一丝笑容道：“你还记得刚才念什么了吗？”
我摇了摇头，还真不记得了。
瞎子道：“全忘光了。”
我努力的回想，瞎子刚教我的时候还记得清楚，刚才念了一遍，还模糊的有些记得，这会竟然全忘光了。
见了鬼了，怎么连一个字一个音都不记得了。
我惊道：“怎么会这样。”
瞎子说：“你尽管再念一次。”

我说我都忘光了还怎么念，瞎子说让我念就念。
说来也奇怪，对着香炉咒语竟然脱口而出。
在念咒的时候我心思沉静，物我两忘，脑中一片清明。
不知不觉咒语又念完了。
咒音落尽，我有些不敢相信道：“我，我刚才又念了？”
瞎子点了点头说：“你果然通灵。”
“通灵？”
瞎子说：“每一行都要天赋，唱歌的要嗓子，运动员要体魄，而我们这一行最好能通灵，先干活有机会再跟你细说。”
你想说我还不愿意听呢。
要不是最近招惹了不干净的东西，我才懒得问，搞得我很想知道似的。
瞎子原本还让我准备一只烤猪的，但我那有那个钱，就换成了一只鸡，公鸡还不行，说是公鸡身上阳气太重非要老母鸡。
老母鸡可是下蛋的宝贝，也不便宜。
搞到最后我偷偷摸摸的把我家里的老母鸡给偷了出来，这要让我老妈知道还不晓得会怎么教训我。
把烤得油光发亮的老母鸡放在盘里摆在小铜鼎的前面。
做完这一切我才跑回瞎子的身旁。
瞎子说：“好了，开始喊吧。”
我问道：“怎么喊？”
瞎子道：“你没听过人喊魂吗？那些淹死在河里找不到尸体的，或者客死异乡的都要喊魂。”
瞎子这么一说，我貌似听人喊过，就学着喊了起来：“回来吧，师傅，回来吧……”
瞎子道：“得喊名字，谁知道师傅喊的是谁？”

我师傅姓陈名坚。
我喊道：“回来吧，陈坚……”
“回来吧……”
“陈坚……”
喊声在黑夜中回荡，虽然知道是自己在喊，但回荡的声音依旧让我感到渗的慌。
“回来吧……”
“陈坚……”
阴风一阵一阵的，吹的桥头的烛光不停的摇曳。
瞎子说：“撒一些元宝纸钱。”
我从塑料袋里抓了一把纸钱，往天空高高抛起，一边撒纸钱，一边喊着：“陈坚回来吧，陈坚回来吧……”
这些对我们只是纸钱，但在师傅眼中可就是白花花的真钱。
“回来吧……”
“陈坚……”
喊魂都是一刻钟，过了这个时间是没用的，可一直喊了十几二十分钟也没有看到师傅的踪迹。
瞎子道：“你师傅恐怕不会回来了，或者说他回不来。”
想起师傅要成为孤魂野鬼饱受日晒雨淋之苦，我的心里很不是滋味：“怎么会这样，我师傅为什么不回来？”
瞎子道：“他有可能是想回回不来。”
这时村里传来唢呐吹响的声音，伴随着唢呐声响是一阵阵哭声。
是要出殡了。
农村人都迷信，认为提前出殡会招凶厄，很多亲朋好友都不敢来。

送殡的人就少了。
队伍稀稀落落的从师傅家出发往后山走去。
瞎子说：“我们也赶紧过去。”
队伍的最前面是送葬队的，一边走一边向着天空撒纸钱，大声高喊：“新人出殡，生人避让。”
而后是倩倩抱着师傅的遗照。
紧接着就是阴棺了。
一叶也在队伍行列，他穿了一身土黄色的道士法袍，背后是一个显目的八卦图案。
我跟瞎子跟上队伍。
驼背就跟瞎子说：“没放噙口钱，子孙钉没栓红绳，棺材也没加杉木。”
驼背说的这些我在瞎子给我的那本书上都见过。
噙口钱一般都是古代的铜钱，放进嘴里再取出来，听说不放的话，下辈子会是哑巴，但要是不取出来的话家财会被带走。

content_en:
As soon as night fell, the village was eerily quiet.
The blind man and I came to Minghualiu Bank.
The river is not wide, only seven or eight meters, and the bridge is a bluestone bridge.
I took four red candles and placed them at the four corners of the bridge, and then lit them with firewood.
The candlelight shone in the dark night like four ghostly will-o'-the-wisps trembling in the night.
This is a true guiding light.
The blind man warned: "It's a red candle, don't take it by mistake."
Red and white are opposite.
I said, "Yes, it's a red candle."
I then took a small copper cauldron and placed it in the center of the bridge, burned another stick of incense, and then inserted the incense into the small copper cauldron with special respect.
I muttered a spell that the blind man taught me.
After reciting it, I forgot what I recited.
I was worried that I didn’t pronounce it correctly, so I asked the blind man: “Did I pronounce it correctly?”
The blind man's green and black face showed a rare smile and said: "Do you still remember what you just read?"
I shook my head, I really didn’t remember.
The blind man said: "I forgot everything."
I tried hard to recall. I still remembered it clearly when the blind man first taught it to me. I still vaguely remembered it after reciting it just now, but now I had completely forgotten it.
Damn it, I can't even remember a single word or sound.
I was shocked: "How could this happen?"
The blind man said, "You can read it again."
I said I had forgotten all about it, so why should I recite it? The blind man just recited it if he asked me to.
Strangely enough, he blurted out the incantation to the incense burner.
While reciting the mantra, my mind was calm, I forgot about things and myself, and my mind was clear.
Unknowingly, the mantra was finished again.
After the curse finished, I couldn't believe it and said, "I, did I just recite it again?"
The blind man nodded and said, "You are indeed psychic."
"Psychic?"
The blind man said: "Every profession requires talent, singing requires a voice, athletes require physical fitness, and in our profession it is best to be psychic. We will work first and then I will tell you in detail when I have a chance."
What you want to say I don’t want to hear yet.
If it hadn't been for the dirty things I've provoked recently, I wouldn't have bothered to ask, which makes me want to know.
The blind man originally asked me to prepare a roasted pig, but since I had the money, I replaced it with a chicken. The rooster was not good enough. He said that the rooster had too much yang energy and had to use an old hen.
Old hens are precious eggs, and they are not cheap.
In the end, I secretly stole the old hen from my house. If my mother knew about it, she didn't know how she would teach me a lesson.
Place the shiny old hen on a plate in front of the small copper tripod.
After doing all this, I ran back to the blind man.
The blind man said: "Okay, let's start shouting."
I asked: "How to shout?"
The blind man said: "Have you never heard people shouting for their souls? Those who drowned in the river and could not find their bodies, or those who died in a foreign land, all screamed for their souls."
When the blind man said this, I seemed to have heard someone shouting before, so I imitated shouting: "Come back, master, come back..."
The blind man said: "You have to call your name. Who knows who the master is calling?"
My master's surname is Chen Mingjian.
I shouted: "Come back, Chen Jian..."
"Come back..."
"Chen Jian..."
The shout echoed in the dark night. Although I knew it was me shouting, the echoing voice still made me feel panicked.
"Come back..."
"Chen Jian..."
The dark wind blew in waves, causing the candlelight on the bridge to sway constantly.
The blind man said: "Spread some ingot paper money."
I grabbed a handful of paper money from the plastic bag and threw it high into the sky. While scattering the paper money, I shouted: "Chen Jian, come back, Chen Jian, come back..."
These are just paper money to us, but in the eyes of the master, they are real money in vain.
"Come back..."
"Chen Jian..."
It takes a quarter of an hour to call out the soul. After this time, it is useless. But I have been calling for more than ten or twenty minutes and there is no trace of the master.
The blind man said: "I'm afraid your master won't come back, or he won't be able to come back."
I think of my master becoming a lonely ghost and suffering a lotBeing exposed to the sun and rain, I felt very uncomfortable: "Why is this happening? Why doesn't my master come back?"
The blind man said: "He may not be able to come back."
At this time, the sound of the suona was heard in the village, and accompanied by the sound of the suona, there were bursts of crying.
There's going to be a funeral.
Rural people are superstitious and believe that an early funeral will bring bad luck, so many relatives and friends are afraid to come.
There are fewer people attending funerals.
The team set out from the master's house sparsely and walked towards the back mountain.
The blind man said: "Let's go there quickly."
At the front of the procession was the funeral procession. As they walked, they threw paper money into the sky and shouted loudly: "New people are in the funeral, strangers should stay out of the way."
Then there is a photo of Qianqian holding her master's body.
Next is the Yin Coffin.
Kazuye was also in the team. He wore an earthy yellow Taoist priest's robe, with a conspicuous Bagua pattern on the back.
The blind man and I followed the team.
The hunchback said to the blind man: "I didn't put any money, I didn't tie the red rope on the nails, and I didn't add fir wood to the coffin."
I have seen what the hunchback said in the book the blind man gave me.
Pout money is usually an ancient copper coin. It is put into the mouth and then taken out. It is said that if you don't put it in, you will be mute in your next life, but if you don't take it out, your family wealth will be taken away.
